replay.keyFinding: Across all 8 replayed cases (n=58 gold frames), W1 flip-segmentation deleted ZERO correct-ownership frames from the selected track (lostToSegmentDeletion=0 everywhere). The remaining wavea S3→S4 loss (16→5, -11) is top-1 RANKING loss among many overlapping target-owned tracks produced by noisy LINUX-CPU proxy detections — e.g. wavea-944403-dink: winner track 9 hits 1/11 gold while sibling target-owned tracks 15 and 7 each hit 4/11; scores are within the coverage×meanScore×proximity band. This mirrors the known 'rally1 13/20 ceiling' class, not a new destructive segmentation case.
